status: Prototype for the proposal; overall target budgets are contributor-confirmed, while implementation guardrails and benchmark verifier are not finalized.
command_policy: The evaluator supplies one fixed mapping of test-command IDs to exact argument arrays, identical across all conditions.
experience_loading: The same read-only experience file tools and loader serve each condition; only assigned package contents differ. Loading/reading time and resulting prompt tokens consume target budgets.
model_identity: The trusted launcher must verify pinned model/runtime bytes and bind the controller endpoint to its own process; the controller alone does not attest endpoint identity.
target_code_execution: Existing Linux Harness rsi-isolate required, without network; no Windows or same-user fallback.
budget_policy: Contributor-confirmed overall caps: 900 seconds, 30 model generations, 128000 cumulative input/output tokens, whichever is reached first; all conditions share these caps and retries consume the same attempt allowance. See evaluation-decisions.json for counted units. Additional guardrails remain required explicit inputs; no defaults are supplied.
outcomes: An agent finish remains unverified until the separate leakage verifier checks the executed pipeline.

validation.dual_gpu_native_adapter: Both workers passed concurrent inference, exact action/token checks, all49layers CUDA offload and CUDA KV allocation; no generated action executed.

previous_inference_snapshot.note: Historical single-GPU CUDA12.4/12-CPU-thread preflight; not the selected two-worker configuration.

worker_policy: Two independent local model workers, one serialized slot per GPU, no sharding. Both normal and batch CPU thread counts equal inference.threads (six per worker). Freeze a goal-balanced case-to-worker assignment before results; all conditions for a case use the same worker. Keep each experience version frozen until all its evaluations close.
